Hi Lena,

Great to meet you and Carlos earlier — thank you for walking through the WaveHealth use case and the three priority workflows (clinician notes, patient summarization, and search/rerank). Per our call, I pulled together the key next steps so we can lock a technical deep-dive with the right folks on both sides: 

- Redwood will run a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive to cover runtime performance expectations, data controls (VPC/KMS options), and a short end-to-end demo of the integration pattern.
- WaveHealth to confirm the attendees for the deep-dive and whether there are any specific compliance or network constraints we should prepare for (IP allowlist, egress rules).
- I attached a short 'deep-dive setup checklist' that lists what we'll need (sample prompt patterns, expected QPS, sample model preferences).

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 6 Oct, 10:00–11:15
- Wed 7 Oct, 14:00–15:15
- Thu 8 Oct, 09:30–10:45

If none of those work, share two windows that do and we'll accommodate. Once you confirm a slot and attendees, we'll send a calendar invite with the Zoom link and a short agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Monica Patel
